_comment: Editable icon registry for the viz 'who fights who' panels. `agents` maps the saved agent.name (claude/codex/alan) to its icon (static/icons_agents/). `families` maps a model FAMILY (the leading letters of the model name, e.g. Qwen/GLM/Kimi, or else a family name found as a word inside it, e.g. sonnet/opus/haiku/fable in claude-sonnet-5) to one logo (static/icons_models/) covering all its models. `models` can override a specific model's icon or text badge and give its params_b (billions). Identity comes from saved agent.name/model, independently of experiment labels. Model lookup first uses the full model identifier, then its name without provider/quantization. Icon lookup: models[name].icon -> families[family] -> text badge. Size: params_b, else parsed from the name (-235B-, -70B-), else mid; sized by `sigmoid`. Task previews are pre-rendered into static/icons_tasks/<task>.png by scripts/gen_task_previews.py (never at viz time). `icon_styles` configures per-asset background, padding_px and object_fit (e.g. light plates for dark logos) without altering the image files.
_params_note: params_b for models whose name embeds no size (parseable ones like -70B-/-235B- are read from the name). Authoritative from ClusterControl docs/model_study.md; `estimate: true` = inferred from a same-family sibling (shown with a ~ in the viz), confirm with model_inspect.py on the served dir. DeepSeek-V4-Flash and MiniMax-M2.7 are intentionally omitted (no grounded size) -> mid-size icon until filled.
